title: Asado Uruguayo
description: Asado Uruguayo is a dish from Uruguay featuring beef short ribs, pork ribs, fresh pork sausage, chimichurri. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 65 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 65 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Rest the cooked meat loosely covered for about 12 minutes before slicing to retain juices.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
